dialogue.english: Good morning, Nadia. How are you?

dialogue.transliteration: sbah nnur. labas l7amdulillah. wash wslatek rrisala dyal lmudir?
dialogue.english: Good morning. Fine, thank God. Did you get the manager's message?

dialogue.speaker: حمزة
dialogue.arabic: إيه، وصلاتني. عندنا اجتماع على العاشرة.
dialogue.transliteration: ah, wslatni. 3andna ijtima3 3la l-3ashra.
dialogue.english: Yes, I got it. We have a meeting at ten.

dialogue.speaker: نادية
dialogue.arabic: واخا، وأنا مازال ما كملتش التقرير.
dialogue.transliteration: wakha, w ana mazal ma kmmeltsh ttaqrir.
dialogue.english: OK, and I haven't finished the report yet.

dialogue.speaker: حمزة
dialogue.arabic: خاصك تكمّلو قبل الاجتماع. الشيف صعيب شوية.
dialogue.transliteration: khassek tkemmlu qbel l-ijtima3. shshif s3eeb shwiya.
dialogue.english: You need to finish it before the meeting. The boss is a bit strict.

dialogue.speaker: نادية
dialogue.arabic: عارفة. ياك المدير باغي يهضر معايا؟
dialogue.transliteration: 3arfa. yak lmudir baghi yhder m3aya?
dialogue.english: I know. The manager wants to talk to me, right?

dialogue.speaker: حمزة
dialogue.arabic: إيه، بعد الاجتماع. وشوف، الطابعة خربات مرة خرى.
dialogue.transliteration: ah, b3d l-ijtima3. w shuf, ttaba3a kherbat merra khra.
dialogue.english: Yes, after the meeting. And look, the printer broke down again.

dialogue.speaker: نادية
dialogue.arabic: ديما هكا! غادي نطبع من عند الزميل ديالنا.
dialogue.transliteration: dima hakka! ghadi nteb3 mn 3end zmilna.
dialogue.english: Always like that! I'll print at our colleague's.

dialogue.speaker: حمزة
dialogue.arabic: واش كاينين شي ساعات إضافية هاد السيمانة؟
dialogue.transliteration: wash kayneen shi sa3at idafiya had ssimana?
dialogue.english: Are there any overtime hours this week?

dialogue.arabic: ما عرفتش. الخلصة كتجي فآخر الشهر، إن شاء الله كاين شي حاجة زايدة.
dialogue.transliteration: ma 3reftsh. lkhlasa katji f akhir shshhar, in sha2 llah kayn shi 7aja zayda.
dialogue.english: I don't know. Pay comes at the end of the month, God willing there'll be a bit extra.

dialogue.speaker: حمزة
dialogue.arabic: إن شاء الله. يالاه، نمشيو للاجتماع.
dialogue.transliteration: in sha2 llah. yalah, nmshiw l-ijtima3.
dialogue.english: God willing. Come on, let's go to the meeting.

pair.english: Is there any leave this month?

lessons.culture: فالمغرب، الخدمة كتبدا عادة على الثامنة والنصف أو التاسعة، وكيتشرب أتاي أو قهوة مع الزملاء قبل الاجتماع. الهضرة فالمكتب كتخلط بين الدارجة والفرنسية، وكلمات بحال «الكونجي» و«الشيف» و«ريونيون» كتتسمع بزاف.

dialogue.arabic: عندي الامتحان غدا وما فهمتش المحاضرة مزيان.

dialogue.transliteration: l7uquq. w nta? f ashmen sna nta?
dialogue.english: Law. And you? What year are you in?

dialogue.transliteration: lkhizana katbqa maftu7a 7ta l-lil, nmshiw nqraw tma.
dialogue.english: The library stays open until night, let's go study there.

dialogue.speaker: عمر
dialogue.arabic: واخا، ولكن خاصني نسلم الفرض قبل الجمعة.
dialogue.transliteration: wakha, walakin khassni nsellem lfard qbel ljem3a.
dialogue.english: OK, but I have to hand in the assignment before Friday.

dialogue.speaker: هند
dialogue.arabic: نديرو جوج حوايج فنفس الوقت. صحابنا غادي يجيو تماك.
dialogue.transliteration: ndiru juj 7wayj f nafs lwqt. sa7abna ghadi yjiw tmak.
dialogue.english: We'll do both at the same time. Our friends will come there.

dialogue.speaker: عمر
dialogue.arabic: الله ينجحك إن شاء الله.
dialogue.transliteration: llah ynejjhek in sha2 llah.

dialogue.english: Lamya, what do you plan to do after you graduate?

dialogue.arabic: بغيت نكمل قرايتي فالماستر، وغادي نحاول ندخل للدكتوراه.

dialogue.english: My dream is to open a small restaurant in Casa.

dialogue.transliteration: fikra mzyana! walakin qbel, khassek tkhdem shwiya f shirka.
dialogue.english: A great idea! But first you should work a bit at a company.

dialogue.speaker: كريم
dialogue.arabic: عندك الحق. غادي نقدم على خدمة فشركة كبيرة، ومن بعد نشوفو.

dialogue.english: You're right. I'll apply for a job at a big company, and then we'll see.

dialogue.speaker: لمياء

dialogue.transliteration: ahamm 7aja hiya tkun mrta7 f lkhedma dyalek.
dialogue.english: The most important thing is to be comfortable in your job.

dialogue.speaker: كريم
dialogue.arabic: الله يوفقنا جوج إن شاء الله.

challenge.title: Talk About Your Work or Studies
challenge.instructions: Write and say a short Moroccan conversation of at least 10 lines about your work or studies and your plans for the future. Use at least 8 target phrases from Unit 8 and include both a masculine-address form and a feminine-address form.
required_elements: A question about profession using شنو كتخدم or شنو كتخدمي.
An answer naming a job or field of study.
A question about where someone works or studies using فين.
A mention of years of experience or year of study using سنة or سنين.
A future plan using غادي or بغيت or ناوي.
A mention of an ambition or dream using الطموح or الحلم.
The phrase إن شاء الله after a future plan.
A closing exchange such as الله يوفقك or بسلامة.

dialogue.speaker: خالد
dialogue.arabic: مايا، شنو كتخدمي دابا؟
dialogue.transliteration: Maya, shnu katkhdemi daba?
dialogue.english: Maya, what do you do now?

dialogue.speaker: مايا
dialogue.arabic: كنخدم محامية فمكتب صغير. وانت؟
dialogue.transliteration: kankhdem mo7amiya f maktab zghir. w nta?
dialogue.english: I work as a lawyer in a small office. And you?

dialogue.speaker: خالد
dialogue.arabic: أنا باقي كنقرا الاقتصاد فالجامعة، فالسنة الرابعة.
dialogue.transliteration: ana baqi kanqra liqtisad f ljam3a, f ssna rrabi3a.
dialogue.english: I'm still studying economics at university, in the fourth year.

dialogue.speaker: مايا
dialogue.arabic: ما شاء الله. ومن بعد التخرج، شنو ناوي تدير؟
dialogue.transliteration: ma sha2 llah. w mn b3d ttakharruj, shnu nawi tdir?
dialogue.english: God bless. And after graduating, what do you plan to do?

dialogue.speaker: خالد
dialogue.arabic: غادي نقدم على خدمة فشي بنك، إن شاء الله نلقى حاجة مزيانة.
dialogue.transliteration: ghadi nqeddem 3la khedma f shi bank, in sha2 llah nlqa 7aja mzyana.
dialogue.english: I'll apply for a job at a bank, God willing I'll find something good.

dialogue.speaker: مايا
dialogue.arabic: وفين غادي تكون من هنا لخمس سنين؟
dialogue.transliteration: w feen ghadi tkun mn hna l-khmes snin?
dialogue.english: And where will you be in five years?

dialogue.speaker: خالد
dialogue.arabic: الطموح ديالي هو نولي مدير فبنك كبير.
dialogue.transliteration: ttumu7 dyali huwa nwelli mudir f bank kbir.
dialogue.english: My ambition is to become a manager in a big bank.

dialogue.speaker: مايا
dialogue.arabic: وأنا الحلم ديالي هو نحل مكتب ديالي.
dialogue.transliteration: w ana l7olm dyali huwa n7ell maktab dyali.
dialogue.english: And my dream is to open my own office.

dialogue.speaker: خالد
dialogue.arabic: شحال هادي وانتي كتخدمي فهاد المكتب؟
dialogue.transliteration: shhal hadi w nti katkhdemi f had lmaktab?
dialogue.english: How long have you been working in this office?

dialogue.speaker: مايا
dialogue.arabic: هادي جوج سنين. الحمد لله، الخدمة ديالي مزيانة.
dialogue.transliteration: hadi juj snin. l7amdulillah, lkhedma dyali mzyana.
dialogue.english: Two years. Thank God, my job is good.

dialogue.speaker: خالد
dialogue.arabic: الله يوفقك، آ مايا.
dialogue.transliteration: llah iwaffeqek, a Maya.
dialogue.english: May God grant you success, Maya.

dialogue.speaker: مايا
dialogue.arabic: ويوفقك. بسلامة!
dialogue.transliteration: w iwaffeqek. bslama!
dialogue.english: And you. Goodbye!
